title: New Jersey drone flap and the Disclosure Day shoot
summary: Jesse Michels tells of New Jersey drone flap and the Disclosure Day shoot, about November 2024 at New Jersey, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: further, uh my buddy Chris Ramsey, who runs a great show called Area 52, he has a theory that uh uh maybe the UFO flap that showed up, the drones over New Jersey in November of 2024, this thing, you know, disclosure day was filmed in New Jersey in late 2024.
Disclosure Day started production in February of 2025, just a few months after the crazy New Jersey drones flap of UFOs being seen across the state.
tellings.difference: Says production started in February 2025, a few months after the flap, where the story says filming was in late 2024; names Morris County and Picatinny Arsenal; does not credit Chris Ramsey.
tellings.link_reason: Both link the New Jersey drone flap to the filming of Disclosure Day in New Jersey; the host tells both.

as_told.title: New Jersey drone flap before Disclosure Day filming
as_told.place_text: New Jersey; Morris County; Picatinny Arsenal

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, links two things that happened in New Jersey. In late 2024, many people across the state reported mysterious drones and lights in the sky, and around the same time Steven Spielberg's alien film Disclosure Day was being made there. Michels credits the idea to his friend Chris Ramsey, who hosts a show called Area 52, and floats that the sightings and the film might be connected. In a later episode he says filming began in February 2025, a few months after the sightings, and mentions Morris County and Picatinny Arsenal, a military base in the state.
